description.en: Its distinguishing construction is flattened slipper-shaped horn closed by a hinged semicircular lid; retain this geometry rather than treating it as a recolor, scale or pose variant. Original stylized teaching art. Palette, nominal size, pose and simplified details are artistic choices; no scientific reconstruction or coexistence claim.
description.zh: 以扁拖鞋形角杯由铰接半圆盖封闭为独立造型依据；须保留这些结构差异，不能仅靠换色、缩放或姿势区别。 原创风格化教学道具；配色、标称尺寸、姿态及简化细节是美术选择，非严格科学或同域共存复原。

author: Leon Made This / s010s

sources.title: Structural-functional aspects in the evolution of operculate corals (Rugosa)
sources.supports: Calceola slipper shape and single operculum; Goniophyllum pyramidal shape and multiple lids; reconstructed soft bodies are hypotheses.

warnings_disposition: Smooth shading is intentional on continuous organic parts. Flat honeycomb calices are deliberate. Parts are closed; semantic parts may overlap at anatomical attachments.

source_warnings_review.smooth_normals: Intentional organic smoothing on closed meshes; reviewed in clay, color and actual GLB views.
source_warnings_review.mounting: Grounded meshes have lowest authored Z=0 and corresponding exported glTF Y=0.

scientific_scope.en: Independently reviewed original stylized-inspired static teaching art. Palette, pose, nominal dimensions and simplified anatomy are artistic choices; not a strict scientific reconstruction or coexistence claim.
scientific_scope.zh: 通过独立审查的原创静态风格化启发教学美术；配色、姿态、名义尺寸及简化解剖属于美术选择，不作严格科学复原或同域共存主张。
